events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. On this day in '69, Woodstock kicked off. Which artist would you have loved to see on that iconic stage?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the undisputed King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his legacy – truly unmatched. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Rock
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders legend continues to inspire with her powerful voice and unapologetic rock 'n' roll spirit. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The man, the myth, the legend – still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top track from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine (UK Single) Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine A Better World
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' became an anthem for peace and hope. On this day in '75, John Lennon's powerful message hit the UK airwaves. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' in '62. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we honour the enduring impact of John Lennon. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The world remembers the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the one and only Freddie Mercury. A showman, a vocalist, a legend whose music continues to rock the world. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
